column1: uikit-choice-v1|singleline-negative|Our long shipping options stop after one line when someone chooses a large text size. Can you keep the full option readable without changing which option is selected?

uikit-choice-v1|fixedfont-negative|The title in our choice row stays small inside a view with a larger content-size override. Can you make it follow the effective environment and keep the existing text style?
uikit-choice-v1|staleselection-negative|Choose delivery, then switch back to pickup. The old option still reports itself selected. Can you make every selection cue agree after switching twice?
uikit-choice-v1|clobberedtraits-negative|Selecting an option removes traits another part of the app installed. How should this component change its own state while preserving the rest?

uikit-containers-v1|wrongspan-negative|Our seating chart has a seat that spans multiple coordinates. Looking it up by the first coordinate works but another covered coordinate gives the wrong result. Can you repair the table lookup?
uikit-containers-v1|stalemodal-negative|Escape removes the overlay visually, but the accessibility configuration still describes a modal. Can you make both dismissal paths leave a consistent state?

uikit-containers-v1|ignoredenabled-negative|Disabling this control stops normal interaction, but its accessibility activation can still submit. Can you align its return value and callback behavior in both states?

uikit-contrast-v1|nolinearization-negative|Our contrast checker gives suspicious ratios for gray on white even though black on white looks right. Fix the calculation and give me a numerical case that distinguishes the two.

uikit-contrast-v1|wrongcolorspace-negative|The design tool and our checker disagree when a swatch is supplied in a linear color space. Can you make equivalent displayed colors yield comparable ratios?

uikit-contrast-v1|ignoredtraits-negative|The same dynamic foreground and background give us the same audit result under two explicitly supplied appearances. Can the checker honor the appearance being audited?

uikit-contrast-v1|ignoredalpha-negative|My checker returns a definitive contrast ratio for a translucent overlay even when its backdrop is unknown. Can you implement the documented opaque-only policy?
uikit-dynamic-v1|staleaction-negative|A retained accessibility action for yesterday’s result can still change the reused result view. Can you fix that while keeping the new result actionable?
uikit-dynamic-v1|duplicatecallback-negative|Our result exposes two named shortcuts. Invoking a single shortcut can deliver the operation twice. Can you verify the actual dispatch of both?

uikit-dynamic-v1|missingelements-negative|After sorting results, the container’s exposed elements no longer match the visible items. Can you update the order while preserving the identity of surviving elements?
uikit-dynamic-v1|retainedremoved-negative|A removed result stays alive after its owner drops it. Can you show whether the accessibility index or container is holding it and repair the removal path?
uikit-edited-rotor-v1|characteroffsets-negative|Searching for a word after a family emoji highlights the wrong text. Can you return the intended substring without changing the user's selection?
uikit-edited-rotor-v1|ignoredoverlap-negative|Our text search is supposed to include overlapping matches. Looking for “ana” in “banana” misses a result. Can the rotor visit both positions in order?

uikit-edited-rotor-v1|missingrestart-negative|After a document edit, a search that starts from a retained result continues from the old position. Can it restart according to the current document revision?
uikit-edited-rotor-v1|oldrotor-negative|A saved rotor from the previous search still returns matches after the query changes. Can the current search work while the old one expires?

uikit-edited-rotor-v1|staletext-negative|Another controller can change the text view directly. A cached match then points into unrelated text. How should the search respond before its owner rebuilds the index?

uikit-lifecycle-v1|wrongnotification-negative|The motion preference is correct at launch but changing it while the screen is visible doesn't update the view. Can you fix observation and show the change is delivered?
uikit-lifecycle-v1|unstopped-negative|After leaving this screen, preference changes still call back into its observer. Can you fix stop and restart, including the first value after returning?
uikit-lifecycle-v1|staleedit-negative|After a document becomes read-only its button still exposes editing actions. Can you update only the metadata owned by this feature?

uikit-media-inspection-v1|loadedasseekable-negative|Our video inspector enables scrubbing over buffered content even when the player reports no seekable range. Can the inspector distinguish those states?
uikit-media-inspection-v1|fullmeansready-negative|The inspector promises smooth playback whenever the buffer is full. How should it represent a full buffer when the player still says it may stall?

uikit-media-inspection-v1|inferredlive-negative|Before a finite video finishes loading, our inspector sometimes calls it a live stream. Can you represent what is known about its duration without inventing a stream type?

uikit-media-metadata-v1|allaudiodescribed-negative|An ordinary alternate language track shows up as audio description. Can you make inspection use evidence from the track while leaving playback untouched?

uikit-media-metadata-v1|noitemabsent-negative|Opening the inspector before a player item exists tells users there are no accessible tracks. Can you distinguish unavailable inspection from a known empty result?

uikit-media-metadata-v1|selectionlost-negative|Our media inspector reports the chosen audio track as unselected. Can you report the real selection accurately while keeping the player and its subtitle Off state unchanged?
uikit-media-v1|hiddencontrols-negative|Embedding the player removes the ordinary transport controls our users rely on. Can you restore native controls and preserve automatic media selection?
uikit-media-v1|forcedonly-negative|When full English subtitles are requested, our picker sometimes chooses a forced-dialogue-only option. Can you select the intended track and retain the Off path?

uikit-modal-v1|lostbackground-negative|The panel can open over content that was already hidden from accessibility. Closing it should restore either original setting. Can you handle both starting states?
uikit-modal-v1|earlynotification-negative|The screen-change request fires before the closing animation finishes. Can it use the target that is eligible when dismissal actually completes?

uikit-modal-v1|stalecompletion-negative|Open the panel again before the first dismissal finishes and the old completion closes the new panel. Can you repair the callback and show what happens between completions?
uikit-modal-v1|ignoreddismissguard-negative|Our panel can close while dismissal is disabled. Can you make both entry points respect the current policy?
uikit-modal-v1|detachedtarget-negative|A button is still retained in memory after removal from the window. Closing the panel should avoid requesting focus on it. Can you exercise that exact case?
uikit-naming-v1|exposeddecoration-negative|A decorative icon in our order row is appearing as a separate accessibility element. Can you exclude the icon while preserving the actionable content?
uikit-naming-v1|hiddencontrols-negative|Our row has two independently operated controls. The row’s accessibility configuration now hides the controls. Can you restore access to both controls?
uikit-naming-v1|stalenames-negative|We reconfigure a visible row without dequeuing it again. It continues to advertise the previous order’s names. Can you repair live reconfiguration?
uikit-preferences-v1|ignoredmotion-negative|When Reduce Motion is on, this transition still takes the animated path. Can you keep the final content update and prove which transition was requested?

uikit-preferences-v1|stalehint-negative|Our form succeeds on its second submission, but still offers the previous error’s recovery hint. Can you reset the stale state and preserve the successful result?
uikit-speed-v1|repeatedchange-negative|Choosing the already-selected speed emits another playback change. Can you keep repeated selections quiet and still notify exactly once when the rate changes?
uikit-speed-v1|ignoreddisabled-negative|A disabled speed control still changes the playback rate through a direct selection request. Can you repair the command path and verify re-enabling it?

ios-closure-v1|validation-generation|Two validations finish in reverse order. The earlier response can replace the newest field errors. Can you drive the captured completions and keep the current result?
ios-closure-v1|validation-snapshot|The user edits a native field while validation is pending, without submitting again. The result still attaches to the edited value. Can you fix that case?
ios-closure-v1|media-identity|Another controller replaces the player item directly during inspection. Can you ensure the old item's completion cannot publish results for the new one?
ios-closure-v1|media-duplicate|A loader calls its completion twice. After the first result is displayed, the second delivery can overwrite it. Can you enforce the intended one-result policy?
macos-appkit-v1|lostordinarysave|The accessibility shortcut still saves, but our visible Mac Save control no longer does. Can you restore its ordinary route and verify each route dispatches once?
macos-appkit-v1|disabledshortcut|While saving is disabled, invoking the accessibility shortcut still changes the app. Can you repair the disabled path and preserve the enabled action?
macos-closure-details-v1|keyboard-disabled|A disabled control can still toggle when its keyboard handler receives the event directly. Can you make disabled behavior agree across entry points?
macos-closure-v1|text-boundary|Searching this Mac document can return part of a composed character. Can you restrict matches to whole text boundaries while keeping valid adjacent matches?
macos-closure-v1|state-text|The selected state is visible by color alone after this row refreshes. Can you keep a non-color label and its accessibility value synchronized on deselection too?

macos-lifecycle-v1|foreigntarget|When an editor closes after its original responder moved into another window, it tries to restore the wrong target. Can you exercise that move and use the eligible fallback?
macos-lifecycle-v1|original-responder-check|Our original responder is still attached but refuses first responder. Can the return path use the fallback without sending keyboard events?
macos-lifecycle-v1|oldgeneration|A preference update queued before stop arrives after we restart observation. Can you prevent it from overwriting the new session’s effective preference?
macos-navigation-v1|lostselection|Two invoices have the same displayed title. Sorting them loses the selection. Can you preserve the selection across the reorder?
macos-navigation-v1|duplicateids|A malformed refresh repeats an invoice ID. Reject the refresh without changing the previous rows or selection. How would you prove nothing was partly applied?
macos-navigation-v1|disabledkeyview|After a form action becomes disabled it remains in our owned Tab cycle. Can you rebuild the cycle in the supplied order with only eligible controls?
macos-navigation-v1|leakedkeylinks|Removing a button from the form leaves its old next-key-view link alive. Can you release the links this helper installed during refresh and teardown?
macos-structure-v1|invalidsave|Submitting an invalid value can still invoke Save. Can the form retain the entered text, surface the error, and wait for a valid submission?
macos-structure-v1|reentrant|Our save handler can synchronously call back into the form. One submission then invokes Save twice. Can you protect the actual dispatch path?
macos-structure-v1|identity|Renaming an outline node recreates it, even though it represents the same document. Can you preserve the surviving node object through refresh?
macos-structure-v1|stalenode|An outline data-source callback for a removed parent still returns children. Can you reject stale parent requests while current parents continue working?
macos-structure-v1|selection|When a selected child’s siblings change order, the outline selects a different child. Can you restore the intended item after refresh?
tvos-results-v1|stalebutton|A retained result button can still choose an item after the shelf has been rebound. Can the current button respond to Select while the old button is inert?
tvos-results-v1|motionhidescontent|On Apple TV, enabling Reduce Motion also prevents the updated status text from appearing. Can you separate the visible result from the optional animation?
tvos-results-v1|repeatedanimation|Refreshing an unchanged status keeps replaying its animation. Can you keep repeated updates quiet and still animate a genuine change when permitted?
tvos-structure-v1|grouping|Each shelf needs a heading and independently operable item buttons. The container now absorbs them. Can you restore the structure without changing the data order?
tvos-structure-v1|detached|A retained shelf button that was removed from the hierarchy still chooses an item. Can you make the same generation work for attached buttons only?
tvos-uikit-v1|lostordinarydetails|The Details shortcut works but the ordinary Details action on our television screen is broken. Can you repair it and exercise the two entry points independently?
tvos-uikit-v1|invalidfocustarget|The preferred focus list includes a disabled control after a state change. Can you return eligible candidates and preserve their intended order?

tvos-uikit-v1|original-missing-titles|The shortcut has a contextual name but sighted users can’t tell what the visible action buttons do. Can you restore their ordinary titles and preserve the shortcuts?
macos-v1|interop|After SwiftUI updates this represented view, an action retained before the update can still dispatch. Can you test a rebind through the coordinator used by the view?
macos-v1|semantics|Writing the same value twice through our SwiftUI binding repeats the side effect. Can you preserve genuine value changes and suppress duplicates?
macos-v1|documents|A document row has been rebound but its saved action can operate on the replacement document. Can the new action work while the retained one expires?
macos-v1|preferences|Our SwiftUI preference policy requests animation even when Reduce Motion is enabled. Can you show both preference paths end in the same state while animation policy differs?
mac-target-control-v1|old-target|After a represented AppKit control is replaced, the old native control can still send an action. Can you test both the old sender and the replacement?
media-macos-v1|cancel|Cancellation of an earlier caption load clears the newer load’s state. Can you demonstrate overlapping requests and keep the newer one alive?
media-macos-v2|staleoff|An Off action retained by an old caption menu can clear selection after a menu reload. Can you repair and exercise the binding that the menu actually uses?
media-macos-v2|unmappedoff|The native player has a forced subtitle option selected, but our full-caption menu reports Off. Can the menu distinguish an unrepresented selection from no selection?
